notes.title: A Huge Thank You, Our Next Steps, and More!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Greetings, Faeologists![/p][p][/p][p]Firstly, we’d like to thank you for all the support and interest we’ve received so far, and for taking the time to play the demo! We’re currently at 8k+ wishlists, and we couldn’t have done it without all of you. It’s also been a lot of fun sharing the demo and hearing your thoughts along the way.[/p][p][/p][p]Since the revamped demo was released on May 21st, we’ve made many improvements, but we've yet to publish patch notes detailing them. So far we have:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed major and minor bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the script (added some missing details, provided clearer clues)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tools - items interaction[/p][/*][*][p]Put in additional information in the Faerie Encyclopedia and made it more organized[/p][/*][*][p]Made visual improvements while using the magnifying glass and blacklight[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition, we have decided to trim the dialogues leading up to the investigation phase, specifically the responses to Oscar’s letter, so players can begin investigating sooner. This change also reflects our feeling that Oscar’s route needs a rework, especially with the new features we have planned.[/p][p] [/p][p]We understand that the current demo is still far from perfect. We're considering major improvements to it, with the full game design in mind. That means it may take some time, and the current demo will remain as-is (except for bug fixes) until the next big update.[/p][p]Our plans are still under wraps, of course 😉, but we can share a few things about our next steps:[/p][list][*][p]We're aiming to make the game much more interactive, with a variety of new features.[/p][/*][*][p]A major rework of the UI/UX to make the experience smoother and to support these interactive elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Ruthie Blythe and at least one other new character will appear in Chapter 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Features to support accessibility, such as changeable text size and font, and more. [/p][/*][/list][p]With that in mind, your feedback is very valuable as we continue developing Death & Faeology. If you’d like to share your thoughts, you can drop them here:[url="https://forms.gle/G7BFWYQutcTngeio6"] [/url][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/G7BFWYQutcTngeio6"]https://forms.gle/G7BFWYQutcTngeio6[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, we’d also like to share a bit about our other ongoing project, [b]Ookami Okami[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324116/fb9a4cd00c7a9286a26d9ee91c634e17856dff2e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ookami Okami is a visual novel with interactive point-and-click elements, where you play as a once-elderly innkeeper who has been reborn into a stunning youkai form in the Spirit Realm. There, you can experience slowburn romance with the White Tiger God, enjoy point-and-click minigames (cleaning rooms, exorcising spirits, and collecting relics), and explore the inn using a map, surrounded by gorgeous art with beautiful Japanese aesthetics. The demo is coming soon! If you're interested,[/p][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703750/Ookami_Okami/" style="button" buttoncolor="#cc5200"]Wishlist Ookami Okami here[/url][/p][p]
[/p][p]Thanks again, and we’ll see you in the next big update![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Reworked Demo is now LIVE
notes.notes:
Greetings, Faeologists!

[h3]We're excited to announce that our majorly reworked demo is now LIVE as part of the Otome Games Celebration![/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n6vripB.jpeg[/img]

Following your feedback from the last demo, we’ve completed a major overhaul of the narrative and script to deepen character development, refine investigation and deduction mechanics, and fully immerse you in the 1920s atmosphere.

An overview of the changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Major script rewrite to give characters more depth and better reflect the 1920s vibe.[/b]
Many dialogue options are changed for better flow after narrative rework.
[*] [b]Character personality changes:[/b] 
[b]Florence[/b], who was once portrayed as an unreliable chemist obsessed with the occult, now is a skilled chemist with a lively personality, though there’s a hint of sorrow beneath her cheerful exterior.
[b]Theodore[/b], who was previously portrayed as hot-tempered and single-minded in his pursuit of justice (with occasional poetic flair), now is more composed and direct, while still retaining his natural cynicism and skepticism toward all things fae-related.
[*] [b]More comprehensive deduction phase with the detective.[/b] In the previous demo, there were only two answers for each question. Now you must present your deduction of the culprit with the right evidence. Theo can sniff you out if you are making up stuff!
[*] [b]Changes to certain evidence items[/b] (hair samples into blood samples) and the inclusion of new ones (e.g. wedding ring) to enrich the investigation experience.
[*] [b]Two additional endings[/b], from five to seven.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/26Uk5EF.jpeg[/img]
With these changes, we hope to provide a more polished and immersive experience that reflects the full vision for Death & Faeology.

We'd also like to invite you to check other wonderful visual novels showcased in the event and celebrate otome games with us!
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/OtomeGamesCelebration?l=english][b]Otome Games Celebration Steam Page[/b][/url][/h3]

We hope you try the updated demo now and dive into the mystery of Death & Faeology!

notes.title: A Huge Thank You and Where We're Headed
notes.notes:
Greetings, Faeologist!

As the Visual Novel Fest comes to a close, we would like to thank you for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts with us. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify areas for improvement.

💠 You can still share your feedback of the demo: [url=https://forms.gle/M7RUhrJjgcZxgJDc9]Death & Faeology Demo Feedback[/url]

While we’ve addressed several bugs and made some enhancements, we feel the demo is still far from where we’d like it to be. With that in mind, we will be taking the demo down from Steam for now so we can focus on further improvements and fully dive into the development of Chapter 1.


Here's a little sneak peek at what’s coming in chapter 1:
[list]
[*]The appearance of Ruthie Blythe, the childhood friend (which will also be romanceable in the full game)
[/list][list]
[*]Continuation of the current case and more mysteries to solve
[/list][list]
[*]Minerva will be romanceable
[/list]

We also wanted to let you know that, in addition to the Death & Faeology team, we have another team currently working on a brand-new game for this year’s Otome Jam! If you’re interested in following updates for both Death & Faeology and our upcoming project, feel free to follow us on any of our social media :)

Thank you once again for your support! 💛
